title: Veteran ready to buy with VA loan
scenario: Recently separated Army veteran has found a house and wants to move fast with a VA loan. He asks about documents, timeline and costs; the rep answers without quoting numbers.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Jamal? This is Renee with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yes ma'am, thanks for calling back so quick.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Of course. I see you're interested in a VA purchase loan?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yes. I got out of the Army in June and I've got a job lined up with the county. My wife and I found a house we love.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Thank you for your service. Congratulations on the job and the house. Have you made an offer yet?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Not yet, our agent wants a pre-approval letter first. How fast can you get me one?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: If you get me the documents today, we can usually turn around a pre-approval quickly once I've reviewed everything.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay, what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Your DD-214, your Certificate of Eligibility if you have it, the offer letter from the county, and a couple months of bank statements.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I've got the DD-214 right here. Not sure about the certificate.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: No problem, we can request that for you.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Great. Will I have to put any money down with VA?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Many VA buyers don't need a down payment, but it depends on your entitlement and the price, so I'll confirm that once I see your eligibility.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Got it. And what about the funding fee, how much is that?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: It depends on whether it's your first use and on any disability rating, so I'll lay out the exact figure in your loan estimate rather than guess.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Makes sense. I do have a rating, actually.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That could make a difference, so include your VA award letter as well.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Will do. Once we're under contract, how long until we can close?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: It depends on the appraisal and the seller, but I'll give you a realistic timeline as soon as we have a contract.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Perfect. How do I send all this stuff?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I'll text you a secure upload link right after we hang up.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Sounds good. My wife's going to be thrilled.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Let's get you that letter. Talk soon, Jamal.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Thanks, Renee.
